query:
SELECT id, workingTitle, blueprintGenerated, 
  CASE WHEN blueprintContent IS NULL THEN 'NULL' WHEN blueprintContent = '' THEN 'EMPTY' ELSE 'HAS_DATA' END as blueprint_status,
  CASE WHEN essentialData IS NULL THEN 'NULL' WHEN essentialData = '' THEN 'EMPTY' ELSE 'HAS_DATA' END as essential_status
FROM storyBlueprints WHERE id = 150001;
